concerns_addressed: Independently inspected the T6 spec at bfc20aed0e885e5afc3970b38d4ea566545a8c04 and the 0869c716e90d074e8be2297558fd806c4b5049ae correction diff: the serial six-test outlet → admin → driver → finance → history flow is present, using real seeded accounts/data, with UI actions and API oracles.

The spec imports createLogger from e2e/support/logger.ts and logs each test step on success and failure with durationMs; it does not reimplement the shared logger. Per-test new browser contexts isolate the UI roles, with contexts closed in finally blocks.

Primary interaction selectors use data-testid (including dynamic admin and delivery IDs); the quantity controls use an aria-label locator rather than a text-based selector. The paid badge is an assertion locator, not a primary action selector.

Verified the Chromium-only project, workers: 1, fullyParallel: false, and retain-on-failure/only-on-failure artifact settings in apps/web/playwright.config.ts. No Firefox/WebKit projects or dummy-mode paths appear in the spec.

The 0869c71 correction added assertions for invoice total/zero paid/unpaid status, stored delivery recipient and proof URL, receipt reference, Paid state/badge, and ordered status history. No backend/API business-code change is part of the T6 correction.
The bfc20ae correction to scripts/purge-e2e-artifacts.sh only groups the find name predicates; it does not alter the browser test flow or its configuration.
Scanned the reviewed spec for secret-like values and Firefox/WebKit references; none were found. Test account credentials are the explicit seeded test credentials from the specification.

strengths: The suite uses six descriptive tests under test.describe.serial and the project configuration further constrains execution to one Chromium worker.
Every test calls the shared JSONL logger in success and catch/failure paths; browser contexts are closed in finally paths.

Business-state checks include order invoice totals and unpaid balance at approval, persisted delivery proof, payment receipt reference and Paid order state, toast presence, Paid badge, and status-history ordering.
The purge predicate change correctly scopes -mtime +7 deletion to supported artifact file types; it is unrelated to T6 behavior.

issues.description: A few DELIVERABLE details are not directly asserted: the assignment test only verifies a delivery ID (not assigned status/driver_id or order still Confirmed); the delivery test verifies stored recipient/proof but not delivered status/delivered_at or order Delivered; and the payment test verifies receipt and order Paid but not payment status or invoice paid/balance 0.00. Existing later status-history and Paid assertions provide partial state coverage, but explicit assertions would make the individual business invariants more robust.

The QUALITY BAR requests a toast presence-only check; the spec checks visibility and also asserts that the success element contains the receipt reference. The separate API receipt-reference assertion already verifies the reference, so this extra UI text assertion is stricter than the stated toast contract and may be more coupled to UI copy/rendering.
